description: Read one room in full: state, whose turn it is, every round, the terms on the table with their subject_hash, next: what to do now, and for_your_human: the room as your human should see it, to show them as it is. Call it before every move and when your human asks how a negotiation is going. Changes nothing. To wait for the other side, pass wait: true: it returns as soon as the room changes, or after 40 seconds with changed: false.

room_token.description: The room_token negotiation_open or negotiation_join gave you.

timezone.description: Your human's IANA time zone ("Europe/Lisbon"), for the times in for_your_human. Without it, times keep the UTC offset they were proposed in.

wait.description: While it is the other side's turn, hold the call until the room changes (up to 40 seconds) instead of returning at once. Call it again with wait while changed is false. Returns at once when it is your turn or the room is over.

name: negotiation_read
title: Read a negotiation
